notes.title: New Endless Mode + Big Fixes!
notes.content:
Bricks Over Blocks – Endless Mode Update
We’re excited to release our Endless Mode Update! This build brings a brand-new way to play, visual upgrades, bug fixes, and more.
New Features
Endless Mode Added

Play in Endless Forest and Endless Cave environments

New Endless Mode UI with selection screen

Work-in-progress save system to track your Endless runs

Visual & Animation Updates

New Bat model with flying and dismount animations

New Fish model that scales naturally as it approaches the camera

Forest Blocks with updated textures and materials

Leaning left and right animation added for the main character

Bigger main ball for better visibility in gameplay

Bigger projectile explosions for a more satisfying impact
[hr][/hr]Gameplay & Level Updates
Added gaps in Endless brick spawns for improved pacing

Adjusted brick downward speed when only 15 bricks remain

Obstacle spawn timer set to 6 seconds by default

Bats on ceilings will now spawn at spline start in Cave maps

Fish replace the swimming cars in water areas for a better theme

Lowered death collision to fix bubble spawning above water

Modified forest map spline for smoother gameplay
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed Fatal Error crashes

Fixed remaining projectile continuing to fire while paused

Fixed balls slowing down after collisions

Fixed missing fireball in Endless mode after starting bricks

Fixed Bat car beeping and Fish SFX playing on spawn

Fixed gap on level transitions and centered loading screen
[hr][/hr]Under-the-Hood Improvements
Reworked block breakage system (all block types now use BP_Break_Base)

Imported and integrated:

RocketGun, Large Head power-up, and associated animations

Powerup uniform drops and rocket projectiles
[hr][/hr]
This is a big step toward our full Endless experience. Creative Mode is still in progress and will arrive in a future update.

Thanks for playing and keep sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Updates for May 1st 2025 Build
notes.content:
Bricks Over Blocks — Build Update Notes (May 6 2025)
New • End‑of‑Level Score Breakdown
You now get a clean snapshot of every point you gained (and lost) when the win screen pops up.

Positive points


 Bricks broken: +[score]
 Hearts captured: +[score]
 Highest combo: [value]


Penalties


 Blocks hit: –[score]
 Balls lost: –[score]


Extra stats (not scored yet, just info)


 Blocks broken: [count]
 Player health lost: [count]
 Hearts dropped and missed: [count]


Tweaks and Fixes

 Shrunk the slow‑motion trigger on the final brick to cut down on false hits.
 GameMode now decides whether to spawn the Bat or the Car automatically, so cave levels no longer need a manual Bat drop‑in.

notes.title: No Fooling—It’s Our Big April 1st Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First off, we want to send a huge “thank you” to everyone who has purchased Bricks over Blocks on Steam Early Access. Your support directly helps us keep the game growing and improving. We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes and are planning to release updates every two weeks from now on. We have lots of exciting ideas in store, so stay tuned!

We realized we didn’t formally announce the March 13 update, so this post covers both the March 13 and March 24 builds.

Build Mar_13
Bug Fixes

 Ball Respawn: Fixed an issue where the ball wouldn’t respawn correctly after falling.
 Countdown Audio: The countdown at the start of each level now plays correctly with the new audio.
 Ball Stuck: If the ball ever starts moving perfectly straight up and down, it now gets a slight nudge left or right to avoid being stuck.
 HUD Disappearance: Addressed a bug causing the HUD to disappear after playing a level and then opening the settings.
 Mouse Persistence: Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor remained on-screen while playing a level.
 Level Progress: Fixed a bug that caused level progress not to delete properly when playing in the editor.


New Features & Tweaks

 Game Splash Screen: A temporary splash screen is now in place.
 Steam Achievements (WIP): We’ve set up basic plugins to start integrating Steam Achievements in the future.
 Save System (WIP): Began implementing an initial save system for level selection.
 Ball Speed Tweaks: Adjusted the initial ball speed, and it now increases after 30 seconds.
 New Loss Conditions:
 Losing a life: If Blocky falls into the hazard below, you lose big points (3 times and you’re out).
 Running out of time: If the timer hits zero, it’s game over.


Build Mar_24
New Level Content

 Forest Biome (Test Level): Added the first Forest biome level with a new layout and design. (Temporarily disabled from normal gameplay while we refine it, but it’s included for testing!)


Gameplay & System Improvements

 Keybind Persistence: Keybinds now save properly, and there’s a placeholder UI to manage them.
 Dynamic Level Select: The number of level buttons on the selection screen now adjusts automatically based on available levels.
 Refactored Actors & Collisions: Simplified how various objects interact with each other for more consistent behavior.
 Fireball & Sludge Ball Rework: These special balls now inherit from the main ball for improved consistency and fewer bugs.
 Player “Missile” Feature: If Blocky is launched upward by a level obstacle, it can destroy bricks on the way up—like a missile!


Looking Ahead
We’re excited to continue polishing Bricks over Blocks. Updates will now come every two weeks, so expect more new features, refined gameplay, and of course, more levels! Your feedback is crucial, so please keep sharing your thoughts with us on the forums or in the community hub.

Once again, thank you for your ongoing support and patience. Each purchase and piece of feedback helps us make Bricks over Blocks the best it can be.

Stay tuned for more updates—and as always, happy brick-busting!

—The Bricks over Blocks Team

notes.title: Bricks Over Blocks is Moving to a Paid Model – Here’s What You Need to Know!
notes.content:
Hello Block Protectors!

First off, a HUGE thank you to everyone who has played Bricks Over Blocks in Early Access! Your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping the game, and we’re excited to keep improving it.

What’s Changing?
Since launch, our goal has been simple: break the bricks, protect the blocks, and help Blocky on his journey! We originally released Bricks Over Blocks for free in Early Access to gather feedback and refine the experience. Now that we’ve made significant progress and have big plans for the future, we’re transitioning to a paid model to support ongoing development.

When Is This Happening?
We will be switching Bricks Over Blocks from free to paid on Saturday March 22nd 2025.

What Happens to Current Players?

 If you’ve already added the game to your library, you will continue to own it and receive updates as we expand and improve Bricks Over Blocks.
 Future players will need to purchase the game once the transition happens.


Why Are We Making This Change?
Blocky’s mission isn’t over yet! Moving to a paid model will allow us to dedicate more time and resources to refining gameplay, adding new levels, and making Bricks Over Blocks even better.

We appreciate every player who has helped shape the game so far. If you have any questions or thoughts, drop them in the comments—we’d love to hear from you!

Thanks for being part of the adventure, and as always… break the bricks, protect the blocks!

🧱🛡️
The WalterNet Games Team
